zusammenfassung: In the kitchenette Paul cuts the last window into a cardboard model and explains to Ole why he builds every building out of cardboard first. At the end Ole asks what Nordhaven says to so many windows.
kurz: The cardboard model, Ole’s question about Nordhaven.
antagonistenBezug: Nordhaven is introduced as the client.
